_meta.title: CI-011: shell + CLI retirement inventory
_meta.scope: Executable source surfaces and runner operations in the current worktree. Prose-only documentation mentions and generated JSON faces are counted as references but are not executable operations; nested .worktrees, .git, target, and buck-out are excluded.

classification_values.delete: Surface should disappear; do not replace with another shell/CLI wrapper.
classification_values.migrate_to_console_api: Operation belongs in cloud-ci Rust gates, generated adapters, product/service APIs, ops console, cloud-scm/cloud-ci controller, or declarative GitOps; current shell/CLI is bridge only.
classification_values.irreducible_glue_ledger_entry: Current surface maps to one of ADR-0523 closed ledger items; keep narrowly scoped, pinned/reproducible, and re-justify on any touch.

irreducible_glue_ledger.allowed_shape: Pinned release/tag plus sha256/digest verification at graph edge; do not add build/gate logic here.
irreducible_glue_ledger.retirement_pressure: Move downloads into buck2 toolchains/download_file where possible; remaining first bootstrap remains ledger-bound.

irreducible_glue_ledger.allowed_shape: Single ambient SCM facts/materialization edge before cacheable actions; byte-validated generated faces feed in-graph gates.
irreducible_glue_ledger.retirement_pressure: Keep edge singular; shell body can become Rust/controller, but ambient SCM read remains graph-edge ledger item.

irreducible_glue_ledger.allowed_shape: Generated adapter-level checkout with full history for SCM facts; never gate logic.
irreducible_glue_ledger.retirement_pressure: Generated forge/owned-runner adapter may emit it; do not delete shallow-proofing.

irreducible_glue_ledger.allowed_shape: Pinned, documented one-shot runbook/controller edge for physical/endpoint bring-up only.
irreducible_glue_ledger.retirement_pressure: Move automatable desired-state render/apply into GitOps/CAPI/tofu/controller/ops console; keep only physical one-shot residue.

irreducible_glue_ledger.allowed_shape: Pinned reindeer generator and checked-in fixups/overlays; wrap as buck2 run //tools:buckify.
irreducible_glue_ledger.retirement_pressure: Remove bash patch orchestration; generator itself remains out-of-graph by design.
